d:
Bihar men subah aur rat ke tapman men giravat ke sath thand ka asar barhne laga hai. 17 navanbar ko pure rajy men mausam shushk rahega, jabki subah kaee ilakon men kohra chhane ki sanbhavna hai.
Mausam vibhag ke mutabik, agle do dinon men nyuntam tapman 1 se 3 digri tak gir sakta hai. uttar-purv bihar ke kuchh jilon men din ka para 34 digri tak pahunchne ka anuman hai.
Bangal ki khari men ban rahe chakravati tuphan ka bihar par philhal koee alart nahin hai. janie agle dinon men aapke jile ka mausam kaisa rahega.
